notes: ACCESS: tier (a) direct HTTP sufficed throughout (curl_cffi impersonate=chrome124), same platform family as sister site West Elm US (SR2) but this UK site runs NetSuite SuiteCommerce Advanced, not Constructor.io - checked robots-we-uk.txt (the site 301s /robots.txt to /robots-we-uk.txt) first: generic User-agent:* with only /?, /registry, /leesa-united-kingdom disallowed, nothing naming Claude/anthropic bots, no block on any tier. Plain curl_cffi GETs of category pages returned only a minimal JS-shell ('Shopping' title, ~5.8KB) because SCA serves its SEO-prerendered HTML only to recognized crawler UAs; switching to a Googlebot UA (impersonate=chrome124 + User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; Googlebot/2.1; ...)) made every category/CMS page return full prerendered HTML (100-180KB) with the real subnav and an embedded '/api/items?c=3572911&commercecategoryurl=...&n=28...' link. TREE: built as the union of (1) the sitemap index at /SitemapFiles/WEUK/sitemap-index-WEUK.xml -> sitemap-*-category-0.xml (511 category URLs), (2) the Googlebot-rendered homepage's full mega-menu + footer sitemap (416 links, same set), and (3) each visited leaf/hub page's own facets-category-cell-anchor subnav. QTY: each leaf's exact count came from GET https://www.westelm.co.uk/api/items?c=3572911&commercecategoryurl=<url-encoded-canonical-path>&country=US&currency=GBP&limit=1&n=28&offset=0&pricelevel=5 (JSON field response.total) - the same REST endpoint the rendered page itself calls to populate its product grid. Every candidate URL was resolved to its <link rel=canonical> first (many nav entries are aliases: e.g. /bed-linen/bed-linen-by-category/throws, /garden/garden-cushions-decor/garden-cushions-blankets, /cushions-decor/organisation/wallshelves-hooks, /cushions-decor/organisation/coat-shoe-racks, and /bath/bath-accessories-decor/baskets-storage all canonicalize to a different real category URL) - only the canonical URL was recorded, avoiding duplicate rows. h1/title of every leaf was checked against the requested slug. EXCLUDED (not fabricated, verified by canonical-resolution): /bed-linen/bed-linen-by-fabric/* (linen/organic-cotton/tencel/velvet) canonicalize to /search or a broken shell - these are search-query links, not real category pages, unlike the analogous 'Bedding by Fabric' on West Elm US which was a genuine category; /cushions-decor/cushions-throws/cushion-inserts canonicalizes to a single product-detail page (/p502); /rugs-curtains/design-resources-rugs-curtains/rug-pads canonicalizes to a single product page (/eco-rug-pad-r784); /rugs-curtains/.../value-rugs, /bed-linen/.../value-duvet-covers, /cushions-decor/decor-solutions/value-cushions all canonicalize to already-recorded categories (promotional 'value' landing aliases); /rugs-curtains/all-curtains-hardware/poles-accessories is curtain hardware, excluded per textile.md 5; /bath/bath-accessories-decor/bathroom-accessories (18 items) sampled via the API - all decorative soap-dish/mirror/waste-bin sets, no storage or textile primary product, excluded; /furniture/design-resources-furniture/storage-solutions canonicalizes to the plain /furniture catalog (a design-guide link, not a real Storage category); all Furniture/Lighting/Wall-Decor(non-organisation)/Tableware-dinnerware-serveware/Bathroom-fixture/Garden-furniture/Sale-Clearance-New/design-crew/design-resources/trends nodes excluded as out of scope or promotional per the brief. Cushions/Rugs/Curtains/Bed-Linen/Organisation/Wall-Organisation parent hub URLs were not recorded (0 or noise totals with valid children present) - only their leaf subcategories, per textile.md 25 and storage.md 34. STORAGE-SPECIFIC: 'Coat & Shoe Racks' (canonical /furniture/hallway/coat-shoe-racks) and 'Wall Shelves & Hooks' (canonical /wall-art-mirrors/wall-organisation/wallshelves-hooks) are both featured inside the site's own 'Home Storage Solutions' organisation hub (title of /cushions-decor/organisation) alongside Baskets & Hampers and Jewellery Storage, even though their canonical URLs live under Furniture and Wall Art & Mirrors departments respectively; kept as Storage per storage.md 10/18/19 explicit inclusion of Shoe Racks and storage-purpose wall shelving/hooks, confidence MEDIUM and flagged given the cross-department canonical path. No blocks encountered at any tier.
